description: You stand in the old plaza beneath the castle of Aínsa as the small hours settle over the Pyrenees foothills. Stone houses with shuttered windows line the square, the castle walls rising dark above them, with only streetlamps and a few lit windows breaking the night. A hushed, timeless view of one of Aragón's finest medieval towns.
